verdict.rationale: Databricks documents its own Auto Loader for incrementally ingesting new files from cloud storage, plus SQL and Spark ingestion APIs as part of its ingestion offering, so loading from object storage is a native capability. However, the evidence names no single bulk-load command and never confirms support for CSV, JSON, or Parquet specifically. Missing for 10: a documented single-command bulk load (e.g., a SQL load statement), explicit CSV/JSON/Parquet format support, independent or hands-on corroboration.
